scientific_integrity: The proof is symbolic. It imports only explicitly identified statements from the cited primary source and reproduces the new congruence-plus-unequal-weight synthesis. No finite computation is used as evidence for the universal claim.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the natural basis of real biquadratic fields. The unit-index loss \(I_m\) is sufficient, not proved optimal. No claim is made for \(\log T\) below a field-dependent constant times \(I_m\), nor for an improved optimal \(p\)-adic exponent.
title: Unequal Peck savings with prescribed divisibility in real biquadratic fields
